intent_contract.storage: compiler-owned private durable state; not an application entity or source-constructible capability
intent_contract.identity: generated nominal UUID ReminderIntentId, committed before any HTTP dispatch; immutable across attempts and reconciliation
intent_contract.revision: created with Todo; every successful patch supplying due_at advances revision and clears reminder_sent_at atomically, even when the supplied value equals the old value; omitted/failed patch does neither
intent_contract.creation: transactional eligible current-revision check and unique insert, or return existing intent; regenerate no identity on conflict/restart
intent_contract.admission: transactionally recheck current revision, visible open overdue unsent Todo, active owner, authorised recipient/effect, immutable payload and retry budget; durably claim exactly one dispatcher and set possible_dispatch before releasing transaction
intent_contract.admission_cut: due-date patch before admission prevents A dispatch; patch after committed admission may race A HTTP, but cannot let A mark B sent
intent_contract.recovery: possible_dispatch surviving crash or missing durable outcome becomes unknown, even if bytes may not have been sent; lease expiry cannot prove no effect
intent_contract.completion: persist valid exact-key receipt plus compiler observation instant against original intent; mark reminder_sent_at with observation instant only in transaction guarded by current matching revision and unsent state; retain stale A receipt without marking B
intent_contract.unknown: persist inspectable unknown by original ID; prohibit automatic resend, replacement ID for same revision and late-worker duplicate dispatch
intent_contract.successor_while_unknown: a new due-date revision may create B, but B dispatch is held while any earlier intent for that Todo remains possible_dispatch/unknown; trustworthy resolution releases B eligibility
intent_contract.receipt_time: validated provider accepted_at is evidence only; compiler-owned wall-clock receipt observation is application reminder_sent_at; neither provider time nor wall-clock ordering grants identity or retry authority

policy_successor.status: narrow owner-selected identity amendment candidate for independent review; base policy bytes unchanged
policy_successor.after: idempotency_key: persisted ReminderIntentId bound to the same authorised Todo and current schedule revision

retry_field_semantics: Whether the injected trace admits an automatic retry at any intermediate failure; final_retry, when present, describes the terminal outcome separately.
